clue.text: Do they provide a view of dogs across India?

indicators.note: the dogs stretch across, so the India letters sit inside them

parts.note: bow-wows is a childish word for dogs

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether some windows look out over dogs on the far side of India.
explanation.definitionFit: Curved windows projecting from a wall are built to give a wide outlook over the street or garden.

clue.text: Act as bearer in shop?

parts.note: to act as something is to be it
a tray is something that bears or carries cups and plates

explanation.surface: Someone works as a porter in a store.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shop' looks like a place, but here it is the slang verb meaning to inform on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone, in British slang, is to inform on them to the police, which is a form of treachery.

clue.text: Women provide weapons, leading practice exercise

parts.note: to arm is to supply with weapons
up means ahead or leading, as in a team being two goals up

explanation.surface: Women hand out weapons before a drill.
explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary session of stretching or light play before a game is a practice exercise.

clue.text: Criminally daring sideline organised by executive?

definitions.text: Criminally daring sideline organised by executive?

indicators.note: organised suggests the letters of the two words are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A bold illegal side business run by a company boss.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue serves as both definition and wordplay: an executive using inside knowledge runs exactly this crooked sideline.
explanation.definitionFit: Trading shares on confidential company knowledge is a crime that a company executive is well placed to commit.

clue.text: Free trade with Peru? That's something different

indicators.note: free signals the letters are released from their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Open commerce with a South American country would mark a change.
explanation.definitionFit: A departure from the norm is a deviation, a new course unlike what came before.

clue.text: Complains, dismissing hotel drinks

indicators.note: dismissing means the hotel letter is sent away from the word for complains

parts.note: to whine is to complain peevishly
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles and turns away the hotel's beverages.
explanation.definitionFit: Wines are alcoholic drinks made from fermented grapes.

clue.text: What may measure resistance if working for the Crown?

definitions.meaning: the initials of On Her Majesty's Service, printed on official British government mail

explanation.surface: Asking what might gauge opposition among royal servants.
explanation.walkthrough: OHMS is the abbreviation once stamped on British official envelopes: On Her (or His) Majesty's Service.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical resistance is measured in units named after Georg Ohm, and the same letters abbreviate royal official service.

clue.text: Part of family history from the man I left in kitchen, for example

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
taken as written

indicators.note: in places the left letter inside the word for a kitchen

parts.note: a kitchen is an example of a room

explanation.surface: A man leaves something in the kitchen that belongs to the family's past.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasured object handed down through generations forms part of a family's heritage.

clue.text: Flood of pasties regularly supporting most of planet

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting puts the pasties letters underneath the planet letters
most of drops the last letter from the planet's name

parts.note: Saturn is a planet

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of pasties

explanation.surface: A deluge of meat pies propping up a heavenly body.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood something is to soak it completely, filling it until it can hold no more.

clue.text: Church official says piece for politician

parts.note: an elder is an official in some Protestant churches
states means says
a man is a piece in chess or draughts

explanation.surface: A church officer speaks a passage on behalf of a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior, respected politician whose long experience earns wide regard is called by this title.

clue.text: Arrangements to pay for calls?

definitions.meaning: conditions of payment, as in a supplier's credit conditions
names or words for things, as in calling something by a name

explanation.surface: Asking about payment plans for phone calls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Calls' suggests telephone charges, but it is a verb-turned-noun sense: what you call things.
explanation.definitionFit: Payment conditions are called terms, and words or names for things are also terms.

clue.text: Lean on board for guest on game show

indicators.note: on means the leaning word follows the board word in an across answer

parts.note: a panel is a board, a flat piece of wood
to list is to lean over, as a ship does

explanation.surface: Someone leans on a plank to play on a TV quiz.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity sitting on a quiz show's team of guests is a member of the panel.

clue.text: A star looking embarrassed on the way back is in pieces

parts.note: the sun is a star

indicators.note: on the way back means the embarrassed colour word is read backwards

parts.note: red-faced, looking embarrassed

explanation.surface: A celebrity blushing on the return trip is falling apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Torn apart into separate parts, as in the marriage vow phrase about putting things apart.

clue.text: Outstanding students covered by revised rates

indicators.note: covered by means the student letters are held inside the rearranged rates
revised signals the letters of rates are reworked into a new order

parts.note: L is a learner, so two Ls are students

explanation.surface: Excellent pupils benefit from new fee levels.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent like a star, exceptionally good.

clue.text: Solve problems of currency and go away during Tourist Trophy

indicators.note: during places the money and shoo letters inside the race letters

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy, the Isle of Man motorcycle race
the rouble is the Russian currency
shoo is said to tell someone to go away

explanation.surface: Sorting out money worries and leaving during a famous motorbike race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tourist Trophy is a motorcycle race held on the Isle of Man, abbreviated TT.
explanation.definitionFit: To troubleshoot is to track down and fix faults or difficulties.

clue.text: New arc light absorbing energy makes you listless

indicators.note: absorbing puts the energy letter inside the rearranged lamp words
new suggests the letters of arc light take a fresh form

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A fresh lamp soaks up power and leaves you sluggish.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking energy and drowsy, which is what listless means.

clue.text: Warn a receiver, impounding half of monies

indicators.note: impounding means the dish holds the half-word inside it

parts.note: a satellite dish is a receiver

indicators.note: half of takes the first three letters of the six in monies

explanation.surface: Caution someone in charge of receiving goods that are seizing cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To admonish is to reprimand firmly or caution someone.

clue.text: Touched by journalist supporting unlimited offer during performance

indicators.note: in a down clue the journalist supports, so sits below
during puts the trimmed offer inside the performance word

parts.note: an act is a performance

indicators.note: unlimited strips the first and last letters off offer

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: Moved by a reporter backing a generous bid during a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Being touched by something means being emotionally moved by it.

clue.text: Learned if fit for changing this sort of gear

indicators.note: for changing signals the letters of the three words are shuffled

explanation.surface: A scholarly fitter swaps out a car part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Learned if fit' reads as a sentence about fitness, but the twelve letters are the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A differential is a gear arrangement letting a car's wheels turn at different speeds on corners.

clue.text: Chap, for example, with a cellarful of wine for sale

parts.note: a bod is a person or chap, in British slang

explanation.surface: A man, say, holding a cellar of wines to sell.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish wine shop or cellar where wine is stored and sold.

clue.text: The French understand a person who rents

parts.note: les is French for the (plural)
to see is to understand

explanation.surface: French people grasp the role of a tenant.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant holding property under a lease is the party paying rent.

clue.text: Common ground for parking after a lover gets frisky!

indicators.note: after puts the parking letter at the end
gets frisky suggests the letters of a lover romp into a new order

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Somewhere to park once a sweetheart turns playful.
explanation.definitionFit: Shared territory where two things cover the same area, like intersecting circles.

clue.text: Elegance of model travelling across Italy

indicators.note: travelling across means the model word spans the Italy letter

parts.note: to model is to pose
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: A model's grace as she tours Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Graceful, composed bearing is a kind of elegance.

clue.text: A group of workers backed working with eastern plant

indicators.note: backed means the workers word is turned backwards

parts.note: men are a workforce, as in the boss and his men
on means working, as in a machine being on

explanation.surface: Staff who reversed in operation with an oriental crop.
explanation.definitionFit: The anemone is a flowering plant of the buttercup family.

clue.text: Popular dénouement must include time and meaning

indicators.note: must include means the time letter goes inside the combined words

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
the dénouement is the ending of a story

explanation.surface: A crowd-pleasing finale needs good timing and significance.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaning to do something is planning or having the purpose of doing it.

clue.text: Fitting end to sports encounters

parts.note: meet is an old word for fitting or proper

indicators.note: end to picks out the final letter of sports

explanation.surface: Appropriate finishes to athletic contests.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet someone is to come across them, so this is a verb form of encounters.

clue.text: Place for looking at animal skin?

definitions.meaning: a concealed shelter for watching birds or wildlife

explanation.surface: Asking about a spot for observing a beast's coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A birdwatcher's shelter and a beast's pelt both share this short word.

clue.text: Recent changes in hotel employee share

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the hotel worker word

parts.note: a page is a hotel errand boy

indicators.note: changes signals the letters of recent are rearranged

explanation.surface: Recent changes to a bellboy's portion.
explanation.definitionFit: A proportion of a whole, expressed per hundred, is a share.
